---
title: "SS3_workflow - SWO Stock Assessment 2026"
author: "Genevieve Phillips"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output: html_document
---

This markdown details the running of the Indian Ocean swordfish stock assessment for 2026 in Stock Synthesis 3.30.

Firstly, the data input are created from data provided by the Data Team at IOTC, by running the markdown found in the folder "1_datainput". Data from the data team are stored in folders in the folder "data", to preserve the data used for the running of the assessment (to make re-running the model easy to do). Each component of the data e.g. CE / CPUE are stored in a separate folder. In the future, code could be updated by linking directly to a URL for the data at the time point of creation for the assessment. 

The data input markdown ingests raw data and outputs the assessment data in the folder "data/SS3_input".

This markdown edits the SS3 input files using the R package "r4ss" using data from that folder. It is worth thoroughly checking each input file sequentially **before** running a model to double check that edits to the input files have been completed as intended.

Each model is run and then diagnostics (basic) are produced.

At the end of the updated models, and sensitivity runs, the ensemble (or "grid") is produced, and run, followed by the KOBE plots necessary for stock status.


```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE)

easypackages::libraries("r4ss", "dplyr")

source("./init.R")

mod_path <- paste0(PATH_MODELRUNS,"0_base_2023",sep="")

```

# Update model with new data {.tabset}

## Start with reference model from 2023: [DONE 10-07-26]

New dataset provided May 2026.

## Updated R etc.

2023 model is called **xxx** in the report. Renamed as **0_base_2023**.

SS3 version = 3.30.25.1

R version = 4.6.0 -- "Because it was There"

```{r run_2023, eval=TRUE}

mod_path_1 <- paste0(PATH_MODELRUNS,"0_base_2023",sep="") ## first run with old exe, then update exe

## TURN OFF FORECASTING

fcast <- SS_readforecast(file.path(mod_path_1, "forecast.ss"))
fcast$Forecast <- 0
fcast$Nforecastyrs <- 0

# benchmark years -- relative to endyr (0), except model-start references stay at 1950
fcast$Bmark_years <- c(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1950, 0, 1950, 0)

# forecast years -- relative to endyr (0), recruitment fields unchanged
fcast$Fcast_years <- c(0, 0, 0, 0, -999, 0)
fcast$Bmark_relF_Basis <- 1   # was 2 -- don't borrow relF years from the forecast section

SS_writeforecast(fcast, dir = mod_path_1, overwrite = TRUE)

starter <- SS_readstarter(file.path(mod_path_1, "starter.ss"))
starter$maxyr_sdreport <- -1   # -1 tells SS3 to auto-set this to endyr
SS_writestarter(starter, dir = mod_path_1, overwrite = TRUE)

r4ss::run(dir = mod_path_1,
          exe = paste0(mod_path_1, "/ss3_win.exe", sep=""), 
          skipfinished = FALSE,
          show_in_console = TRUE,
          console_output_file = "console_output.txt",
          extras = "-nohess",
          verbose = TRUE)

```

## Update catch: [DONE with up to 2024 CATCH 14-05-26]

### Create new model directory using old data

```{r model_directory, eval=TRUE}

update_catch_mod <- paste0(PATH_MODELRUNS,"1_update_catch",sep="")

# make new model folder to update with new catch data
copy_SS_inputs(dir.old = mod_path, dir.new = update_catch_mod, create.dir = TRUE, overwrite=TRUE, copy_exe = TRUE)

```

### Read in SS files

```{r read_inputs, eval=TRUE}
inputs <- SS_read(dir = update_catch_mod)

inputs$start$compatibility <- 1 ## does fuck all - manually edit.
inputs$start$prior_like <- 1

```

### Update years to end 2024

Model is structured in years

```{r update_year, eval=TRUE}

inputs$dat$styr ##1950
inputs$dat$endyr
inputs$dat$endyr <- 2024 

```

### Update rec devs to appropriate final quarter

```{r update_rec_devs, eval=TRUE}

## will need to update these to 2024

inputs$ctl$last_yr_fullbias_adj
# <- 2023
#[1] 2021
inputs$ctl$MainRdevYrLast
# <- 2023
#[1] 2021
inputs$ctl$first_recent_yr_nobias_adj
# <- 2023
#[1] 2021

```

### Update catch data

```{r update_catch, eval=TRUE}

catch <-inputs$dat$catch
new_catch <- read.csv(file = paste0(PATH_SS3_INPUT,"SS3catch2026.csv",sep=""))

new_catch <- new_catch %>% mutate(catch_se = 0.1) ## add generic CV of 0.1 --> Catch initially = 0.01 CV...?
new_catch <- new_catch %>% select(-X)

names(new_catch) <- names(catch)
inputs$dat$catch <- new_catch

```

### Output new catch_model

```{r output, eval=TRUE}

SS_write(inputs, dir = update_catch_mod, overwrite = TRUE)

## DOUBLE CHECK INPUTS

```
 
### Run model - new catch [DONE 10-07-26]

```{r run_new_catch_model, eval=TRUE}

r4ss::run(dir = update_catch_mod,
          exe = paste0(mod_path, "/ss3_win.exe", sep=""),
          skipfinished = FALSE,
          show_in_console = TRUE,
          console_output_file = "new_catch_console_output.txt",
          extras = "-nohess", ##second running do this
          verbose = TRUE)

```

## Update CPUE 

Use data from update_catch, and add in new CPUE data - will have three scenarios:

1) jp + others (no tw)
2) tw + others (no jp)
3) all

But first add the same as the previous reference model:

1) jp sw only to 2003 for some reason. jp rest of areas all years (except final one). Other indices down-weighted so non-informative (0.001 lambda).

```{r update_CPUE}
update_cpue_mod <- paste0(PATH_MODELRUNS, "3_update_cpue",sep="") #new model directory
copy_SS_inputs(dir.old = update_lf_mod, dir.new = update_cpue_mod, create.dir = TRUE, overwrite=TRUE, copy_exe = TRUE)

inputs_cpue <- SS_read(dir = update_cpue_mod)
cpue <- inputs_cpue$dat$CPUE
max(cpue$year)
print(inputs_cpue$dat$CPUEinfo)

ctl <- inputs_cpue$ctl

## First remove extra fleets

ctl$Nfleets ## 22 need to add 2 more
ctl$Nfleets <- 28

## Change fleetnames

ctl$fleetnames <-c("ALGI_NW", "JPLL_NW","TWLL_NW","ALGI_NE","JPLL_NE","TWLL_NE","TWFL_NE","EUEL_SW","ISEL_SW","JPLL_SW","TWLL_SW","AUEL_SE","EUEL_SE","JPLL_SE","TWLL_SE","UJPLL_NW", "UJPLL_NE", "UJPLL_SW","UJPLL_SE","UTWLL_NW", "UTWLL_NE", "UTWLL_SW", "UTWLL_SE", "UIDN_NE","UZAF_SW","UPRT_SW","UREU_SW","UESP_SW")

## Setup the Q for each survey fleet to mirror with an existing fleet

setup_Q <- ctl$Q_options
setup_Q <- setup_Q[-(14:16),]

rownames(setup_Q) <- c("UJPLL_NW", "UJPLL_NE", "UJPLL_SW","UJPLL_SE","UTWLL_NW", "UTWLL_NE", "UTWLL_SW", "UTWLL_SE", "UIDN_NE","UZAF_SW","UPRT_SW","UREU_SW","UESP_SW")
ctl$Q_options <- setup_Q

## Then add the Q params based on 2022 model

Q_params <- ctl$Q_parms
Q_params <- Q_params[-(14:16),]
rownames(Q_params) <- c("UJPLL_NW", "UJPLL_NE", "UJPLL_SW","UJPLL_SE","UTWLL_NW", "UTWLL_NE", "UTWLL_SW", "UTWLL_SE", "UIDN_NE","UZAF_SW","UPRT_SW","UREU_SW","UESP_SW")
Q_params[9,] <- c(-25,	25,	-15.9842,	  0,	  1,	0,	 -1,	0,	0,	0,	0,	0,	0,	0) 
Q_params[10,] <- c(-25,	25,	-14.5541,	  0,	  1,	0,	 -1,	0,	0,	0,	0,	0,	0,	0) 
Q_params[11,] <- c(-25,	25,	-14.6954,	  0,	  1,	0,	 -1,	0,	0,	0,	0,	0,	0,	0) 
Q_params[12,] <- c(-25,	25,	-12.5867,	  0,	  1,	0,	 -1,	0,	0,	0,	0,	0,	0,	0) 
Q_params[13,] <- c(-25,	25,	-12.9393,	  0,	  1,	0,	 -1,	0,	0,	0,	0,	0,	0,	0) 

ctl$Q_parms <- Q_params

## Next remove some discard patterns (size-selex patterns)

size_selex <- ctl$size_selex_types
size_selex <- size_selex[-(29:31),]
size_selex[24,] <- size_selex[27,]
size_selex[28,] <- size_selex[26,]
size_selex[27,] <- size_selex[26,]
size_selex[25,] <- size_selex[26,]
rownames(size_selex) <- c("ALGI_NW", "JPLL_NW","TWLL_NW","ALGI_NE","JPLL_NE","TWLL_NE","TWFL_NE","EUEL_SW","ISEL_SW","JPLL_SW","TWLL_SW","AUEL_SE","EUEL_SE","JPLL_SE","TWLL_SE","UJPLL_NW", "UJPLL_NE", "UJPLL_SW","UJPLL_SE","UTWLL_NW", "UTWLL_NE", "UTWLL_SW", "UTWLL_SE", "UIDN_NE","UZAF_SW","UPRT_SW","UREU_SW","UESP_SW")
ctl$size_selex_types <- size_selex

## Next add two age selex patterns - this is where you mirror another fleet
## PSLS1N (fleet 15) is mirrored to survey 6
## PSLS1S (fleet 9) is mirrored to survey 5

age_selex <- ctl$age_selex_types
age_selex <- age_selex[-(29:31),]

rownames(age_selex) <- c("ALGI_NW", "JPLL_NW","TWLL_NW","ALGI_NE","JPLL_NE","TWLL_NE","TWFL_NE","EUEL_SW","ISEL_SW","JPLL_SW","TWLL_SW","AUEL_SE","EUEL_SE","JPLL_SE","TWLL_SE","UJPLL_NW", "UJPLL_NE", "UJPLL_SW","UJPLL_SE","UTWLL_NW", "UTWLL_NE", "UTWLL_SW", "UTWLL_SE", "UIDN_NE","UZAF_SW","UPRT_SW","UREU_SW","UESP_SW")
ctl$age_selex_types <- age_selex


##lambdas

lambdas <- ctl$lambdas
lambdas <- lambdas[-(14:16),]

rownames(lambdas) <- c("Surv_UJPLL_NW_Phz1","Surv_UJPLL_NE_Phz1" ,                   "Surv_UJPLL_SW_Phz1" ,                   "Surv_UJPLL_SE_Phz1"  ,                 
"Surv_UTWLL_NW_Phz1" ,                   "Surv_UTWLL_NE_Phz1"  ,                  "Surv_UTWLL_SW_Phz1",                    "Surv_UTWLL_SE_Phz1" ,                  
"Surv_UIDN_NE_Phz1",                     "Surv_UZAF_SW_Phz1"  ,                   "Surv_UPRT_SW_Phz1"  ,                   "Surv_UREU_SW_Phz1"   ,                 
"Surv_UESP_SW_Phz1" ,  
"length_ALGI_NW_sizefreq_method_1_Phz1" ,"length_JPLL_NW_sizefreq_method_1_Phz1","length_TWLL_NW_sizefreq_method_1_Phz1", "length_ALGI_NE_sizefreq_method_1_Phz1",
"length_JPLL_NE_sizefreq_method_1_Phz1", "length_TWLL_NE_sizefreq_method_1_Phz1","length_TWFL_NE_sizefreq_method_1_Phz1" ,"length_EUEL_SW_sizefreq_method_1_Phz1",
 "length_ISEL_SW_sizefreq_method_1_Phz1", "length_JPLL_SW_sizefreq_method_1_Phz1","length_TWLL_SW_sizefreq_method_1_Phz1" ,"length_AUEL_SE_sizefreq_method_1_Phz1",
 "length_EUEL_SE_sizefreq_method_1_Phz1", "length_JPLL_SE_sizefreq_method_1_Phz1" ,"length_TWLL_SE_sizefreq_method_1_Phz1")
  
lambdas[9,] <- c(1, 24, 1, 0.001, 1) ##IDN
lambdas[10,] <- c(1, 25, 1, 1, 1) ##ZAF
lambdas[11,] <- c(1, 26, 1, 1, 1) ##PRT

ctl$lambdas <- lambdas

ctl$N_lambdas <- 28


size_selex <- ctl$size_selex_parms

IDN <- size_selex[(76:77),]
PRT <- size_selex[(70:71),]
REU <- size_selex[(70:71),]
ESP <- size_selex[(72:73),]
ZAF <- size_selex[(74:75),]

size_selex[(70:71),] <- IDN
size_selex[(72:73),] <- ZAF
size_selex[(74:75),] <- PRT
size_selex[(76:77),] <- REU
size_selex[(78:79),] <- ESP

size_selex <- size_selex[(1:79),]

ctl$size_selex_parms <- size_selex

## Write out

inputs_cpue$ctl <- ctl

## ADD CPUE DATA
dat <- inputs_cpue$dat

dat$Nfleets
dat$Nfleets <- 28 ## remove fleets

dat$fleetnames <- c("ALGI_NW", "JPLL_NW","TWLL_NW","ALGI_NE","JPLL_NE","TWLL_NE","TWFL_NE","EUEL_SW","ISEL_SW","JPLL_SW","TWLL_SW","AUEL_SE","EUEL_SE","JPLL_SE","TWLL_SE","UJPLL_NW", "UJPLL_NE", "UJPLL_SW","UJPLL_SE","UTWLL_NW", "UTWLL_NE", "UTWLL_SW", "UTWLL_SE", "UIDN_NE","UZAF_SW","UPRT_SW","UREU_SW","UESP_SW")

## Next add fleet type info

dat$fleetinfo <- dat$fleetinfo[-(29:31),]

dat$fleetinfo[24,] <- c(3, 1, 2, 2, 0, "UIDN_NE") ## area 2
dat$fleetinfo[25,] <- c(3, 1, 3, 2, 0, "UZAF_SW")
dat$fleetinfo[26,] <- c(3, 1, 3, 2, 0, "UPRT_SW")
dat$fleetinfo[27,] <- c(3, 1, 3, 2, 0, "UREU_SW")
dat$fleetinfo[28,] <- c(3, 1, 3, 2, 0, "UESP_SW")

## edit length info
dat$len_info <- dat$len_info[-(29:31),]

dat$len_info[24,] <- c( 0, 0.01, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1)
dat$len_info[25,] <- c( 0, 0.01, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1)
dat$len_info[26,] <- c(0, 0.01, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1)
dat$len_info[27,] <- c( 0, 0.01, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1)
dat$len_info[28,] <- c( 0, 0.01, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1)

## add in cpue indices

dat$CPUEinfo <- dat$CPUEinfo[-(29:31),]

allCPUE <- read.csv(file = paste0(PATH_SS3_INPUT,"SS3CPUE.csv",sep="")) ## add in the new CPUE data
max(allCPUE$Year) ## check number of quarters

allCPUE <- allCPUE %>% select(-X)
names(allCPUE) <- names(dat$CPUE)



dat$CPUE <- allCPUE ## replace data

## make sure JPN cpue index doesn't have data in SW from 2003

dat$CPUE <- dat$CPUE[!(dat$CPUE$year %in% 2004:2024 & 
                        dat$CPUE$index == 18), ]

## Write out

inputs_cpue$dat <- dat

```

## Update CPUE 2

Use data from update_catch, and add in new CPUE data - will have three scenarios:

But first add the same as the previous reference model:

1) jp sw only to 2003 for some reason. jp rest of areas all years (except final one). Other indices downweighted so non-informative (0.001 lambda).
2) jp sw all years. Other indices down-weighted so non-informative (as 1).

```{r update_CPUE_2}

max(cpue$year)

lambdas <- ctl$lambdas
lambdas[9,] <- c(1, 24, 1, 0.001, 1) ##IDN
lambdas[10,] <- c(1, 25, 1, 0.001, 1) ##ZAF
lambdas[11,] <- c(1, 26, 1, 0.001, 1) ##PRT

ctl$lambdas <- lambdas

## First remove extra fleets

ctl$Nfleets ## 28 

## Change fleetnames

## ADD CPUE DATA
dat <- inputs_cpue$dat

dat$Nfleets #28

allCPUE <- read.csv(file = paste0(PATH_SS3_INPUT,"SS3CPUE.csv",sep="")) ## add in the new CPUE data
```

## Update recruitment deviations 

Currently set to 1970 to 2020 (last model was 2021 final year of data). There is very low catch from the start of the model until around 1994 so it doesn't make sense to me to have recruitment estimated over this early part as the fishery was not neccessarily a 'target' fishery, and was most likely a 'bycatch' fishery.However for base case model, update just to 1970 to 2023 and then check bias in output.

Finalise base model, then run sensitivities, including one where the recruitment deviates are limited to 1985-2023.

```{r update_rec}

update_rec_mod <- paste0(PATH_MODELRUNS, "4_update_rec", sep="") ## new model directory
copy_SS_inputs(dir.old = update_cpue_mod_2, dir.new = update_rec_mod, create.dir = TRUE, overwrite = TRUE, copy_exe = TRUE)

inputs <- SS_read(dir = update_rec_mod)

# Main Rdev period — deviations ARE estimated in this range
inputs$ctl$MainRdevYrFirst <- 1955
inputs$ctl$MainRdevYrLast  <- 2023

# Make sure main Rdevs are actually turned ON and estimated
inputs$ctl$do_recdev  <- 1            # 1 = devs are estimated (most common option)
inputs$ctl$recdev_phase <- 3          # or whatever phase you use to estimate them (positive)

inputs$ctl$last_early_yr_nobias_adj <- 1955.3   #_last_early_yr_nobias_adj_in_MPD 
inputs$ctl$first_yr_fullbias_adj <- 1999   #_first_yr_fullbias_adj_in_MPD 
inputs$ctl$last_yr_fullbias_adj <- 2023.3   #_last_yr_fullbias_adj_in_MPD 
inputs$ctl$first_recent_yr_nobias_adj <- 2024.3   #_first_recent_yr_nobias_adj_in_MPD 
inputs$ctl$max_bias_adj <- 0.3959  #_max_bias_adj_in_MPD (1.0 to mimic pre-2009 models) 

inputs$ctl$MG_parms[22,] <- c(-8,8,-0.509876,1,99,0,4,0,1,1955,2023,4,0,0)
inputs$ctl$MG_parms[23,] <- c(-8,8,-0.295335,1,99,0,4,0,1,1955,2023,4,0,0)
inputs$ctl$MG_parms[24,] <- c(-8,8,-0.187103,1,99,0,4,0,1,1955,2023,4,0,0)



SS_write(inputs, dir = update_rec_mod, overwrite = TRUE)

```

```{r run_rec_model, eval=TRUE}
r4ss::run(dir = update_rec_mod,
          exe = paste0(update_rec_mod, "/ss3_win.exe", sep=""),
          skipfinished = FALSE,
          show_in_console = TRUE,
          console_output_file = "rec_catch_console_output.txt",
          extras = "-nohess", ##second running do this
          verbose = TRUE)
		  
		  
replist_rec <- SS_output("./4_update_rec/")

SS_plots(replist_rec, minbthresh = 0.20)

```

## Update recruitment deviations 

Currently set to 1965 to 2020 (last model was 2021 final year of data). There is very low catch from the start of the model until around 1994 so it doesn't make sense to me to have recruitment estimated over this early part as the fishery was not neccessarily a 'target' fishery, and was most likely a 'bycatch' fishery.

```{r update_rec_short}

update_rec_mod <- paste0(PATH_MODELRUNS, "4_update_rec", sep="") ## new model directory

dir.create(paste0(PATH_MODELRUNS, "sensitivities", sep=""))
base_mod <- update_rec_mod

update_rec_short <- paste0(PATH_SENSITIVITES, "s1_update_rec_short", sep="") ## new model directory
copy_SS_inputs(dir.old = base_mod, dir.new = update_rec_short, create.dir = TRUE, overwrite = TRUE, copy_exe = TRUE)

inputs <- SS_read(dir = update_rec_short)

# Main Rdev period — deviations ARE estimated in this range
inputs$ctl$MainRdevYrFirst <- 1985
inputs$ctl$MainRdevYrLast  <- 2023

# Turn off "early" Rdevs so 1965-1984 has NO deviations at all
inputs$ctl$recdev_early_phase <- -4   # negative phase = off/fixed at 0
inputs$ctl$recdev_early_start <- 0    # not used when early phase is off, but keep tidy

# Make sure main Rdevs are actually turned ON and estimated
inputs$ctl$do_recdev  <- 1            # 1 = devs are estimated (most common option)
inputs$ctl$recdev_phase <- 3          # or whatever phase you use to estimate them (positive)

inputs$ctl$MG_parms[22,] <- c(-8,8,-0.509876,1,99,0,4,0,1,1985,2023,4,0,0)
inputs$ctl$MG_parms[23,] <- c(-8,8,-0.295335,1,99,0,4,0,1,1985,2023,4,0,0)
inputs$ctl$MG_parms[24,] <- c(-8,8,-0.187103,1,99,0,4,0,1,1985,2023,4,0,0)

# inputs$ctl$last_early_yr_nobias_adj <- 1955.3   #_last_early_yr_nobias_adj_in_MPD

# inputs$ctl$max_bias_adj <- 0.3959  #_max_bias_adj_in_MPD (1.0 to mimic pre-2009 models) 

SS_write(inputs, dir = update_rec_short, overwrite = TRUE)
```

## Growth - TW new study (Wang et al., 2026)

New study from Taiwanese colleagues with male and female growth parameters from anal fins, and otolith data.

```{r new_growth}

new_growth <- paste0(PATH_SENSITIVITES, "s9_new_growth",sep="") #new model directory
copy_SS_inputs(dir.old = base_mod, dir.new = new_growth, create.dir = TRUE, overwrite=TRUE, copy_exe = TRUE)

inputs_new_growth <- SS_read(dir = new_growth)
print(inputs_new_growth$ctl$GrowthModel)
#3

# Von Bertalanffy Growth Function for age in quarters
# VBGF function
vonbert <- function(age, Linf, k, a0) {
  Linf * (1 - exp(-k * (age - a0)))
}

# Where
f_Linf <- 274.31    # Asymptotic length
f_k <- 0.136       # Growth coefficient
f_a0 <- -1.904     # Theoretical age at time= zero

# Where
m_Linf <- 243.01    # Asymptotic length
m_k <- 0.156       # Growth coefficient
m_a0 <- -1.992     # Theoretical age at time= zero

# Generate age in years from age 0-10 (15 * 4 = 60 quarters)
ages <- seq(0, 30, by = 1)

# Calculate lengths
lengths_f <- vonbert(ages, f_Linf, f_k, f_a0)
lengths_m <- vonbert(ages, m_Linf, m_k, m_a0)


age_length_f <- data.frame(ages, lengths_f)
age_length_m <- data.frame(ages, lengths_m)

age_length_f[1,2] -> L_at_Amin_f
age_length_f[31,2] -> L_at_Amax_f
age_length_m[1,2] -> L_at_Amin_m
age_length_m[31,2] -> L_at_Amax_m


all_params <- inputs_new_growth$ctl$MG_parms

# View(all_params)

all_params[2,1:4] <- c(50,80, L_at_Amin_f, L_at_Amin_f)
all_params[3,1:4] <- c(230,290, L_at_Amax_f, L_at_Amax_f)
all_params[4,3:4] <- c(f_k, f_k)

all_params[14,1:4] <- c(50,80, L_at_Amin_m, L_at_Amin_m)
all_params[15,1:4] <- c(230,270, L_at_Amax_m, L_at_Amax_m)
all_params[16,3:4] <- c(m_k, m_k)
```

## Natural mortality - Lorenzen - option 6

Use age 5 as min age (represents 50 % maturity); 12 as max age - represents the oldest fish targetted by the longline fisheries.

Prior = log-normal space = log(0.25) = -1.386294. Use prior option 3 (log-normal space), as recommended by Hamel and Cope (2022).

M = 0.25 is the mean M from the base assessment.

```{r natM_lorenzen}

ctl_natM$Lorenzen_minage <- 5
ctl_natM$Lorenzen_maxage <- 12

ctl_natM$MG_parms[1,1:7] <- c(0.01,1,0.25,-1.386294,0.30,3,-3) ## Prior from Hamel & Cope (2022)
ctl_natM$MG_parms[13,1:7] <- c(0.01,1,0.25,-1.386294,0.30,3,-3) ## Prior from Hamel & Cope (2022)

inputs_natM_lorenzen$ctl <- ctl_natM

SS_write(inputs_natM_lorenzen, dir = natM_lorenzen, overwrite = TRUE)
```

# {.unnumbered}

# ASPM {.tabset}

## ASPM

Use the ss3diags package in R to set up the ASMP (age-structured production model) for the base case model [4_update_rec].

MANUALLY CHANGE THE INPUT FILES.

```{r ASPM}
# remotes::install_github("nmfs-ost/ss3diags")
library(ss3diags)
library(r4ss)

base_dir <- base_mod     # folder containing the finished base-model run
                                    # (control.ss_new, data.ss_new, forecast.ss_new,
                                    #  starter.ss_new, SS3fast_Win64.exe, SS3fast_Win64.par)
root_aspm <- paste0(PATH_DIAGNOSTICS, "ASPM", sep="")
aspm_dir <- paste0(PATH_DIAGNOSTICS, "ASPM/ASPM_base",sep="")     # new folder the ASPM will be built/run in
aspm_rec_dir <- paste0(PATH_DIAGNOSTICS, "ASPM/ASPM_base_rec",sep="")  # second ASPM, with rec devs estimated
exe_name <- "ss3_win.exe"    # SS3 executable
run_exe  <- TRUE                   # set FALSE to just build the files without launching SS3
 
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## STEP 1: create the ASPM folder, copy files, rename *_new / *.par
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
if (!dir.exists(aspm_dir)) dir.create(aspm_dir, recursive = TRUE)

files_to_copy <- c("control.ss_new", "data_echo.ss_new", "forecast.ss_new",
                    "starter.ss_new", exe_name, "ss3.par")
 
for (f in files_to_copy) {
  src <- file.path(base_dir, f)
  if (!file.exists(src)) stop("Missing expected file in base_dir: ", f)
  file.copy(src, file.path(aspm_dir, f), overwrite = TRUE)
}
 
# rename *.ss_new -> *.ss
file.rename(file.path(aspm_dir, "control.ss_new"),  file.path(aspm_dir, "control.ss"))
file.rename(file.path(aspm_dir, "data_echo.ss_new"),      file.path(aspm_dir, "data.ss"))
file.rename(file.path(aspm_dir, "forecast.ss_new"),  file.path(aspm_dir, "forecast.ss"))
file.rename(file.path(aspm_dir, "starter.ss_new"),   file.path(aspm_dir, "starter.ss"))

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## STEP 2: zero out all recruitment deviations in SS3.par
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
parfile <- file.path(aspm_dir, "SS3.par")
 
par <- SS_readpar_3.30(
  parfile   = parfile,
  datsource = file.path(aspm_dir, "data.ss"),
  ctlsource = file.path(aspm_dir, "control.ss"),
  verbose   = FALSE
)
 
# helper: zero every numeric value in a par element, keeping any year/index
# column (if present) untouched
zero_devs <- function(x) {
  if (is.null(x)) return(x)
  if (is.data.frame(x)) {
    keep <- names(x) %in% c("year", "Year", "index", "Index", "yr")
    num_cols <- sapply(x, is.numeric) & !keep
    x[, num_cols] <- 0
  } else if (is.numeric(x)) {
    x[] <- 0
  }
  x
}
 
par$recdev_early       <- zero_devs(par$recdev_early)
par$recdev1            <- zero_devs(par$recdev1)
par$Fcast_recruitments <- zero_devs(par$Fcast_recruitments)
 
SS_writepar_3.30(par, outfile = parfile, overwrite = TRUE)
 
message("Step 2 complete: rec devs zeroed in SS3.par")
 
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## STEP 3: starter.ss -> initialize parameters from SS3.par
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
starter <- SS_readstarter(file.path(aspm_dir, "starter.ss"), verbose = FALSE)
starter$init_values_src <- 1   # 0 = use control-file inits; 1 = use SS3.par
SS_writestarter(starter, dir = aspm_dir, file = "starter.ss",
                 overwrite = TRUE, verbose = FALSE)
 
message("Step 3 complete: starter.ss set to read from SS3.par")
 
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## Read control.ss once -- steps 4, 6, 7 all edit this object, then it is
## written out a single time at the end (see STEP 7)
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
ctl <- SS_readctl(
  file.path(aspm_dir, "control.ss"),
  use_datlist = TRUE,
  datlist     = file.path(aspm_dir, "data.ss"),
  verbose     = FALSE
)
 
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## STEP 4: fix all selectivity parameters at their SS3.par values
## (negative phase => not estimated, just read/held fixed)
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
fix_phase <- function(df) {
  if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) return(df)
  if ("PHASE" %in% names(df)) df$PHASE <- -abs(df$PHASE)
  df
}
 
# NOTE: block names below are the standard r4ss 3.30 control-list names.
# Check names(ctl) for your model -- not every block will be present
# (e.g. no time-varying or Dirichlet-multinomial blocks), and some models
# use age_selex_parms / size_selex_parms only.
selex_blocks <- c("size_selex_parms", "size_selex_parms_tv",
                   "age_selex_parms",  "age_selex_parms_tv")
 
for (b in selex_blocks) {
  if (!is.null(ctl[[b]])) ctl[[b]] <- fix_phase(ctl[[b]])
}
 
message("Step 4 complete: selectivity parameter phases set negative")
 
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## STEP 5: turn off fit to all length-composition data (lambda = 0)
## component 4 = length comps; applied to every fleet with length data
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
set_lambda <- function(ctl, component, fleets, phase = 1, value = 0,
                        sizefreq_method = 1) {
  L <- ctl$lambdas
  if (is.null(L)) {
    L <- data.frame(like_comp = integer(), fleet = integer(),
                     phase = integer(), value = numeric(),
                     sizefreq_method = integer())
  }
  # r4ss has used slightly different column names across versions --
  # detect whichever one holds the likelihood-component code
  comp_col <- intersect(c("like_comp", "component"), names(L))[1]
  if (is.na(comp_col)) comp_col <- names(L)[1]
 
  for (f in fleets) {
    hit <- which(L[[comp_col]] == component & L$fleet == f)
    if (length(hit) > 0) {
      L$value[hit] <- value
      L$phase[hit] <- phase
    } else {
      newrow <- setNames(
        data.frame(component, f, phase, value, sizefreq_method),
        names(L)
      )
      L <- rbind(L, newrow)
    }
  }
  ctl$lambdas <- L
  ctl$N_lambdas <- nrow(L)
  ctl
}
 
n_fleets <- ctl$Nfleet   # number of fleets in the model (check name if this errors)
ctl <- set_lambda(ctl, component = 4, fleets = 1:n_fleets,
                   phase = 1, value = 0, sizefreq_method = 1)
 
message("Step 5 complete: length-comp lambdas set to 0 for fleets 1:", n_fleets)
 
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## STEP 6: fix rec devs at their (now-zero) SS3.par values
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
recdev_phase_orig       <- ctl$recdev_phase
recdev_early_phase_orig <- ctl$recdev_early_phase
 
ctl$recdev_phase       <- -abs(ctl$recdev_phase)
ctl$recdev_early_phase <- -abs(ctl$recdev_early_phase)
 
message("Step 6 complete: recdev phases set negative")
 
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## STEP 7: turn off the recruitment-deviation penalty in the likelihood
## component 10 = recruitment deviations
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
ctl <- set_lambda(ctl, component = 10, fleets = 1,
                   phase = 1, value = 0, sizefreq_method = 1)
 
# write the fully-edited control file once
SS_writectl(ctl, outfile = file.path(aspm_dir, "control.ss"),
            overwrite = TRUE, verbose = FALSE)
 
message("Step 7 complete: recruitment-deviation lambda set to 0; control.ss written")

if (!dir.exists(aspm_rec_dir)) dir.create(aspm_rec_dir, recursive = TRUE)
 
# start from the already-built ASPM folder (selectivity fixed, length
# comps off, starter reading from SS3.par) and copy it wholesale
aspm_files <- list.files(aspm_dir, full.names = FALSE)
for (f in aspm_files) {
  file.copy(file.path(aspm_dir, f), file.path(aspm_rec_dir, f), overwrite = TRUE)
}
 
# re-read the copied control file and switch rec devs back on
ctl2 <- SS_readctl(
  file.path(aspm_rec_dir, "control.ss"),
  use_datlist = TRUE,
  datlist     = file.path(aspm_rec_dir, "data.ss"),
  verbose     = FALSE
)
 
# restore the original (positive) recdev phases so they are estimated
ctl2$recdev_phase       <- recdev_phase_orig
ctl2$recdev_early_phase <- recdev_early_phase_orig
 
# turn the recruitment-deviation likelihood penalty back on (component 10)
ctl2 <- set_lambda(ctl2, component = 10, fleets = 1,
                    phase = 1, value = 1, sizefreq_method = 1)
 
SS_writectl(ctl2, outfile = file.path(aspm_rec_dir, "control.ss"),
            overwrite = TRUE, verbose = FALSE)

```

### Run ASPM models

```{r run_ASPM_models, eval=TRUE}

if (run_exe) {
  message("Running ASPM...")
  r4ss::run(dir = aspm_dir, exe = exe_name, skipfinished = FALSE,
            show_in_console = TRUE)
  
  message("Running ASPM with rec devs estimated...")
  r4ss::run(dir = aspm_rec_dir, exe = exe_name, skipfinished = FALSE,
            show_in_console = TRUE)
 
  ## Optional: quick comparison plot of base model vs. ASPM
  base_out <- SS_output(dir = base_dir, verbose = FALSE, printstats = FALSE)
  aspm_out <- SS_output(dir = aspm_dir, verbose = FALSE, printstats = FALSE)
  aspm_rec_out <- SS_output(dir = aspm_rec_dir, verbose = FALSE, printstats = FALSE)

 
  sumry <- SSsummarize(list(base_out, aspm_out, aspm_rec_out))
  SSplotComparisons(sumry, legendlabels = c("Base model", "ASPM", "ASPM_rec"),
                     plotdir = aspm_dir, print = TRUE)
 
  message("Step 8 complete: all models run; comparison plots saved to ", aspm_dir)
}

```

### Plot ASPM models

```{r plot_ASPM, eval=TRUE}
#
# Step 9) summarize results in R using the r4ss package 
library(r4ss)
# directories where models were run need to be defined
root.dir <- root_aspm
ss3_base_dir <- base_dir
ASPM_base_dir <- aspm_dir
ASPM_base_rec_dir <- aspm_rec_dir

# read models
ss3_base <- SS_output(dir=mod_path)
ASPM_base <- SS_output(dir=ASPM_base_dir)
ASPM_base_rec <- SS_output(dir=ASPM_base_rec_dir)

# create list summarizing model results
mod.sum <- SSsummarize(list(ss3_base, ASPM_base, ASPM_base_rec))

# plot comparisons
SSplotComparisons(mod.sum, legendlabels=c("SS3 (4_update_rec)", "ASPMFixed", "ASPMrec"),print = T, plotdir = paste0(root.dir,"/plots"))

```
